claim.claim-text: 2. The semiconductor package according to claim 1, wherein the semiconductor chip (30; 30a, 30b) comprises a RFIC chip.

3. The semiconductor package according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the at least one build-up layer (120) comprises at least one via (122) and conductive traces (114) therein to route signals, ground, and/or power throughout the bottom chip package (10).

4. The semiconductor package according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein conductive traces (124) on a bottom surface of the at least one build-up layer (120) comprise pads onto which the semiconductor chip (30; 30b) is attached with conductive elements (312; 312b).

5. The semiconductor package according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the core (110) comprises epoxy laminates of fiberglass sheets, prepreg, FR-4 materials, FR-5 materials, or combinations thereof.
6. The semiconductor package according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the discrete antenna device (20) comprises a plurality of antenna modules.
8. The semiconductor device according to claim 7, wherein the substrate (210) comprises a ceramic substrate, a semiconductor substrate, a dielectric substrate, or a glass substrate.

9. The semiconductor device according to claim 7 or 8, wherein the substrate (210) comprises at least one plated through-hole (212) to route signals from one side of the substrate to the other side of the substrate (210).
10. The semiconductor device according to any one of claims 7 to 9, wherein the radiative antenna element (220) is disposed on a second surface of the substrate (210).

11. The semiconductor device according to any one of claims 7 to 10, wherein the top antenna package (220) is a low temperature co-fired ceramic, LTCC, a flip-chip chip-scale-package, FCCSP, a laminate-based package, wire-bond type package or a fan-out type chip package.
